program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((src (first (find-color g 1)))
         (tgt (first (find-color g 2)))
         (motif (filter (lambda (cell)
                          (and (not (= (third cell) 0))
                               (not (and (= (first cell) (first src)) (= (second cell) (second src))))
                               (not (and (= (first cell) (first tgt)) (= (second cell) (second tgt))))))
                        (grid-cells g)))
         (painted
          (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([cell (in-list motif)])
            (let ((rr (+ (first tgt) (- (first cell) (first src))))
                  (cc (+ (second tgt) (- (second cell) (second src)))))
              (if (in-bounds? rr cc (rows g) (cols g))
                  (set-cell out rr cc (third cell))
                  out)))))
    (crop-to-content painted 0)))
